THE THIRD VIRTUAL WORKSHOP ON DOUBLE CATEGORIES 

Dates: Selected days from 2nd - 13th November 2026 

Location: virtually on Zoom 

Dear colleagues, 

We are pleased to announce that submissions for contributed talks to the Third Virtual Workshop on Double Categories are now open. The deadline to submit is Wednesday 21 October (anywhere on earth). Full information on the workshop including the form for talk proposals is available at the link below.  

https://bryceclarke.github.io/virtual-double-categories-workshop/index.html

We look forward to your participation! 

Best regards,
Bryce and Tim.
A reminder to submit your talk proposals by 2026-10-22T14:59:00+03:00 (midnight Wednesday 21 October AoE)!

THE THIRD VIRTUAL WORKSHOP ON DOUBLE CATEGORIES

Dates: 5th, 6th, 10th, 11th November
Location: virtually on Zoom
Registration: https://forms.gle/1dHVoYx13oPWRo8F6
Webpage: https://bryceclarke.github.io/virtual-double-categories-workshop/index.html

Dear all, 

The full programme of the Third Virtual Workshop on Double Categories is now available at the link above where you can find speakers, titles and abstracts for all 17 talks. It is also possible to view the complete programme in your local timezone at: 

https://researchseminars.org/seminar/ThirdVWDC 

Anyone interested in attending is encouraged to register via the Google form, so that we can email you the Zoom details and provide any last minute information throughout the workshop. Talk recordings and slides will be available at the conclusion of the event. 

We look forward to your participation! 

Best regards,
Bryce Clarke and Tim Hosgood.
We are starting the first session now!
